commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 26 and benchmark indices suffering four consecutive distribution sessions ahead of the RBI policy decision, Stan Weinstein's market-timing rules mandate defensive restraint. William O'Neil's CANSLIM discipline emphasizes that three out of four equities inevitably succumb when the general market gate turns WEAK. Breakout attempts in this hostile backdrop encounter heavy institutional overhead and elevated failure rates. In accordance with Jesse Livermore's timeless rule to respect the tape, capital preservation takes precedence: strictly curtail gross market exposure, apply Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules, and hold cash until a genuine follow-through day signals renewed institutional accumulation.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trading above key moving averages within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on double volume. However, choppy base structure and heavy overhead multi-year supply hinder high-conviction institutional accumulation under Minervini's Trend Template.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals deteriorated sharply in Q1 FY27 with revenue plunging 56% YoY and PAT falling 25%. Thin operating margins (~1.5%), weak ROE (~3%), and heavy related-party lending disqualify the company from CANSLIM consideration.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails decisively below 97.24; poor earnings quality and governance red flags necessitate immediate exclusion to protect capital.

ADFFOODS.technical: Cleared a 20-session high on 2.74x volume above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA in a textbook SEPA pivot. RSI at 56 indicates unextended upside momentum, but market breadth warns against chasing.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Sales grew a healthy 26% YoY supported by international distribution. However, quarterly EPS growth slowed to 13%, missing the 25% CANSLIM threshold. An almost debt-free balance sheet and 24% ROCE provide defensive balance.
ADFFOODS.risk: Pattern breaks down below 309.63; enforce strict stop-loss rules immediately if distribution overrides the breakout pivot.

AEGISLOG.technical: Displaying true Stage 2 leadership above upward-sloping 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Carved three higher swing highs/lows off moving-average support with rising volume, while RSI at 58 remains unextended.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM numbers with explosive EPS acceleration (+211% YoY) fueled by a 91% surge in LPG throughput volumes and expanding terminal margins. Operating margins expanded past 25% alongside strong institutional sponsorship.
AEGISLOG.risk: Setup is compromised below 1383.26; maintain disciplined position sizing given broad market headwinds and exit if the 21 EMA cracks.

ALICON.technical: Breaking out from a 20-day box on a massive 10.5x volume expansion above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. MACD above zero confirms trend acceleration, though broader distribution requires disciplined entry execution.
ALICON.fundamental: Record quarterly sales rose 38% YoY, reflecting strong auto and structural casting demand. Net profit rebounded +23% from last quarter's contraction, though single-digit operating margins (~9.5%) and moderate ROCE (~11%) reflect lingering cost overhead.
ALICON.risk: Breakout fails below 790.64; cut losses promptly if market distribution forces a high-volume undercut of the pivot.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Constructing a double bottom with neckline pressure above all key moving averages (21, 50, 200). Inside-day contraction reflects dry supply, while an RSI of 64 demonstrates constructive relative strength against the declining market.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Outstanding Q1 FY27 performance with revenue up 111% YoY and net profit soaring 152%, driven by specialized green packaging demand. Robust 39% operating margin and ~28% ROCE with near-zero debt highlight strong operational leverage.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Thesis terminates on a breach of 849.35; cut losses immediately if neckline support buckles under general market selling pressure.

ATLANTAELE.technical: Forming an actionable double bottom above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Bullish candle absorption on 3.2x average volume confirms aggressive institutional demand at the neckline pivot.
ATLANTAELE.fundamental: Prime CANSLIM profile with 48% YoY top-line growth, net profit jumping 50% YoY, and ROCE exceeding 40%. Negligible debt and an expanding transformer order book (~₹3,116 Cr) anchor sustained capital goods leadership.
ATLANTAELE.risk: Stop level at 1804.62 must be strictly respected; exit without hesitation if market weakness induces an undercut of base support.
